name: Sauna & Heat Therapy
short: Human research on sauna bathing, passive heat exposure and heat therapy.
pubmed_query: (sauna[Title/Abstract] OR "sauna bathing"[Title/Abstract] OR "heat therapy"[Title/Abstract] OR "passive heating"[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH Terms]

name: Infrared Sauna
short: Research specifically involving infrared sauna or far-infrared heat interventions.
pubmed_query: (("infrared sauna"[Title/Abstract]) OR (("far infrared"[Title/Abstract] OR "far-infrared"[Title/Abstract]) AND (sauna[Title/Abstract] OR therapy[Title/Abstract])))

name: Cold-Water Immersion
short: Human studies on cold-water immersion, cold exposure and recovery-related outcomes.
pubmed_query: ("cold water immersion"[Title/Abstract] OR "cold-water immersion"[Title/Abstract] OR "cold exposure"[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH Terms]

name: Contrast Therapy
short: Research involving alternating hot and cold exposure, contrast baths and contrast water therapy.
pubmed_query: ("contrast therapy"[Title/Abstract] OR "contrast water therapy"[Title/Abstract] OR "contrast bath"[Title/Abstract] OR "contrast bathing"[Title/Abstract])
trial_query: "contrast therapy" OR "contrast water therapy" OR "contrast bath"

name: Photobiomodulation / Red Light
short: Human research on photobiomodulation, red light and low-level light therapy.
pubmed_query: (photobiomodulation[Title/Abstract] OR "red light therapy"[Title/Abstract] OR "low level light therapy"[Title/Abstract] OR "low-level light therapy"[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH Terms]
trial_query: photobiomodulation OR "red light therapy" OR "low level light therapy"

name: Floatation Therapy
short: Research on floatation-REST, flotation therapy and reduced environmental stimulation.

name: Massage Therapy
short: Human massage-therapy research across pain, recovery, stress and related outcomes.

name: Sleep & Passive Heating
short: Studies connecting sauna, hot bathing or passive heating with sleep outcomes.
pubmed_query: ((sauna[Title/Abstract] OR "passive heating"[Title/Abstract] OR "hot bath"[Title/Abstract] OR "warm bath"[Title/Abstract]) AND sleep[Title/Abstract]) AND humans[MeSH Terms]
trial_query: (sauna OR "passive heating" OR "hot bath") AND sleep

name: Exercise Recovery
short: Recovery research involving sauna, cold-water immersion or photobiomodulation after exercise.
pubmed_query: ((sauna[Title/Abstract] OR "cold water immersion"[Title/Abstract] OR photobiomodulation[Title/Abstract]) AND ("exercise recovery"[Title/Abstract] OR "muscle soreness"[Title/Abstract] OR recovery[Title/Abstract])) AND humans[MeSH Terms]
trial_query: (sauna OR "cold water immersion" OR photobiomodulation) AND exercise recovery
